name: io.github.DeepCivic/ism-requirements-au
title: Australian ISM requirements and authorisation readiness
description: Derive and track the ISM, Essentials and PSPF requirements for a system, and review a repository for what would stop authorisation. Not an IRAP assessment.

runtimeArguments.description: The folder to review, mounted read-only at /work. Ask for a review of /work.
